reason: I know the Yu Chun name and chik naengmyeon in cold broth is exactly what I want on a hot Honolulu day near Ala Moana, so I would go once on this trip if the recent Google and Yelp reviews and photos hold up. I am only here for a short stay, so one visit, maybe two at most.
objection: Nineteen dollars plus tax and tip for a bowl of cold noodles is a lot compared with what I pay for naengmyeon at home, and if I bring my group of five the 20% gratuity is added automatically, which makes it noticeably pricier.
